selection_policy: Union of the immutable 30-case v6 token baseline and all 16 failed cases from the locked 180-case v6 quality baseline.

query_policy.cases_139_through_180: Use the original question from blueprint/cases-validation.jsonl.

retry_policy: Only network, rate-limit, upstream 5xx, and process-infrastructure failures may be retried. Quality, output-contract, Workflow authoring, validator, and evaluator failures are final.
